source_evidence: src/fx.cpp retains the ordinary TU-local const BasePopTextBlock FxPopupSoundDefaults and its bounded RECOVERY_OBJECT mapping 0x00683AD8..0x00683BF0, anchored to FX::init at 0x00445CD0. No external linkage or executable-byte surrogate was introduced.

Installed match_recovery from master commit 945a843d now verifies ordinary static COFF data through its exact S_LDATA32_ST SECTION/SECREL symbol pair and complete standalone type extent. Fresh VC6 measurements prove the 280-byte FxPopupSoundDefaults allocation and original initial contents in both configured trials. This change was independently reviewed.

recovery/tests/test_fx_initialization.py now requires native initial-data content and boundary passes; real compiler mutations of a default value and the object array extent fail the corresponding observations. Twelve initializer tests pass, including the actual-source call-sequence harness and damage controls. Generic static-data tests reject cross-owner borrowing, linkage mismatch, malformed identities, and global-target export.

This closes only the TU-local constant allocation/initial-data evidence gap. FX::init remains an unclaimed byte mismatch; inherited Sound placeholders, static relocation-target qualification, final-link preservation and whole application runtime acceptance are not established or waived. Task baseline and historical claims are unchanged.
